entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Icelandic Commonwealth, a political institution in Iceland during Norse Settlement of Iceland (930–1000). Grew from Althing, the world's oldest surviving parliament, is established at Þingvellir and Landnám — Age of Settlement. Led to the emergence of Iceland converts to Christianity by decision of the Althing and Commonwealth Governance & Goðar System.
